name: Bomb Defusal
description: One bomb, authored A/B sites on the configured MCC maps, up to 8v8 for Big Team Bomb Defusal. Red attacks first; switch sides after 12 rounds. One life, first to 13 (12-12 draw), 2:30 rounds, 45-second fuse, 4-second stationary plant and 6-second stationary defuse. Equal rifle/pistol starts and one frag, radar off, no automatic map weapons or vehicles. Halo shields and movement retained.
provenance: Newly authored native Assault extension. References game definitions and scenario markers from the user installation; contains no extracted assets.
